info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Cilantro Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: This API enables the creation and management of detailed information for the Cilantro Recliner product in the catalog. By utilizing this endpoint, businesses can streamline the addition of new product details, ensuring that customers have up-to-date information. Typical consumers include e-commerce platforms and inventory management systems that require accurate product representations. This operation supports inventory updates, marketing initiatives, and sales strategies by providing a comprehensive view of product offerings.

post.summary: Create new details for a cilantro recliner.
post.description: This endpoint allows the user to create and submit detailed information regarding a cilantro recliner. It is designed to ensure that all relevant attributes of the recliner are provided to facilitate proper storage and management.
